Dating Mechanisms

Resources on radiometric dating, clocks and half-lives, carbon-14, uranium-235, and the presuppositions behind claims about deep time.

Dating Mechanisms

This page will address dating methods that are often used to argue for an ancient earth. It can examine the assumptions behind radiometric dating, the meaning of half-life calculations, and the philosophical problems involved in treating present measurements as a certain key to the remote past.

It can also introduce readers to questions about initial conditions, contamination, calibration, and the difference between a measurement and the worldview-driven interpretation placed upon that measurement.

Use this page to collect articles, arguments, videos, and tutorials dealing with carbon-14, uranium-235, decay rates, and related issues.
